adjudication.rationale: The diff does drop `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` from `Topic#expandable_first_post?` (topic.rb), so the method now depends only on `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. However, `embeddable_hosts` as a site setting is removed in this PR (site_settings.yml, server.en.yml, SiteSetting method deleted) and replaced by the `EmbeddableHost` model/table, so calling the old guard is no longer possible. The finding’s claimed impact (changed truncation behavior when `embed_truncate` is on but no hosts exist) is plausible for existing embedded topics if all `EmbeddableHost` records are removed, but it’s not clearly a defect nor “data-loss” from what’s shown; it’s a behavioral/UX policy question about whether to also gate on `EmbeddableHost.any?`.
